limitations: All 104 listed originals were individually viewed. Findings describe actual pixels, not DOM geometry.
Raw X11 black area outside the 1100×760 or 760×520 application window is unused desktop canvas.
All 96 selected SAMPLE markers are legible and fully visible beneath the titlebar. All source targets remain literal rather than being replaced by math, graph or footnote previews.

At 200% narrow width in both themes, the root formula's trailing characters extend beyond the right viewport; horizontal scrollbar is visible. This records a partial current source viewport, not proof of inaccessibility. All other 94 target source blocks fit.
Eight narrow-root WebView images confirm the paired X11 observations, including the 200% horizontal boundary and intact statusbar.

Some batched tool displays visually omitted unchanged lower chrome. Individual reread and original pixel checks confirmed intact statusbar; this tool display artifact is not recorded as a product defect.

Independent real End/Home and edge/legend reachability is separately reviewed in candidate11-pixel-review-reachability.json; this static review does not replace that evidence or erase earlier candidate failures.
No UI actions, tests, builds, product/test changes, original-image modifications or heavy image processing were performed.
